name: Connectionist temporal classification
description: PyTorch CTC on [time,batch,class] log-probabilities or logits with explicit input/target lengths and impossible-alignment policy.
usage: loss = ctc(logits, targets, input_lengths, target_lengths, blank=0, zero_infinity=True)

parameters.zero_infinity: zero infinite losses/gradients for impossible alignments

examples.title: Train a CTC acoustic model
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 token=1+int(ctx.index)%3
 features=torch.sin(torch.arange(64,dtype=torch.float32)*(token+1)*0.12)
 return {"features":synth.Tensor(features),"targets":[token]}
ds=synth.Spec("ctc-acoustic",generator=samples,size=24,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("ctc-asr",split="train")
val=ds.for_recipe("ctc-asr",split="val",like=train)
model=build("ctc-acoustic-model","tiny",vocab_size=5,conv_channels=4,hidden_size=8,rnn_layers=1,blank_id=0)
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="ctc-asr",recipe_config={"loss":"ctc","blank_id":0,"zero_infinity":True},max_epochs=1,batch_size=4,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)
